title: Full Day Best of Vancouver Private City and Gardens Tour
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Food and drinks, unless specified (not included)

Suitable for all physical fitness levels

blurb: Combines two of Vancouver's most popular activities - sightseeing and some of our wonderful local public gardens. Start with a grand circle around the most interesting sites Vancouver has of offer and then continue around town for an relaxing afternoon of exotic gardens, and beautiful vistas.
